scope: Synthetic identity-link reference owner; no native or live-model authority
effect: Add right-to-left alias; preserve all original records and sources
assumptions: The controller, evaluator, policy, and disposable-store owner are trusted code.
Source origins and their actual independence/authenticity are assumptions supplied by the trusted synthetic catalog; code counts distinct designated roots, not document count.

The contract cohort includes accurate eligible identities and detectable source disagreements for false identity proposals; false-consistent source assertions are tested separately as assumption challenges.
An owner review binds the exact candidate hash outside the proposer payload.
An operating-system attacker able to rewrite the store or evaluator is outside this experiment.
